bio.text: Scott Wiener has represented California's 11th State Senate District since 2016 and is the Democratic candidate for California's 11th Congressional District in 2026.
He served on the San Francisco Board of Supervisors from 2011 to 2016.
He holds a B.S. from Duke University and a J.D. from Harvard University, and has worked as a clerk for the Supreme Court of New Jersey and as a deputy city attorney in San Francisco.
